run_word_alignment_evaluation: run the eval.py script to evaluate word alignment between source and target embeddings using a test dictionary
run_load_transform: run load_transform to read a transformation matrix from a text file into a numpy array
run_nn_accuracy: run compute_nn_accuracy to measure nearest neighbor accuracy between source and target embedding spaces
run_csls_accuracy: run compute_csls_accuracy to measure CSLS score between source and target embedding spaces
run_load_vectors: run load_vectors to load word embeddings from a file with optional centering and max load limit
